name: News-sentiment capitulation contrarian — buy crypto into an extreme bad-news washout
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the CONTRARIAN counterpart to llm-narrative-pressure-long, which rides POSITIVE news pressure; this FADES extreme NEGATIVE news, and uses news_sentiment, a feature no inbox spec uses): aggregate crypto news sentiment (LLM/lexicon-standardized headline tone in [-1,+1]) spikes deeply negative around shock events (hacks, bans, exchange failures). At those extremes the bad news is already in the tape — the marginal panic seller has sold into the headline, and price tends to mean-revert as the shock is digested (the documented over-reaction-to-bad-news reversal). Buying the sentiment extreme harvests that over-reaction. Entry: news_sentiment below a fitted deeply-negative floor (a bad-news washout) AND price not in structural freefall (a trend floor = the knife guard). Exit: news_sentiment crosses UP back above a neutral threshold (the shock is digested, narrative normalizing) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional dip-buy matches the deflated Sharpe, the sentiment extreme adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: news_sentiment and news_event_score are sibling LLM tone reads; if substituting news_event_score does as well this carries no distinct sentiment-level information. Disconfirmer 3: some bad news is STRUCTURAL (a coin that genuinely dies) — if the edge is only on survivors, that is survivorship, not a reversal edge; the universe must be PIT-honest. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the bounce must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier1 news feature, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: an extreme negative news-sentiment washout — bad-news over-reaction crypto reverts from
